name: elevation-mount-heights
description: H3 — wall elevations annotate the AFFL mount height of every wall-mounted item. Places a wall-mounted TV (1.1 m) + a wall sconce (1.45 m) flush against the same wall, opens the Drawings → Elevations panel, and asserts both '1100 AFFL'/'1450 AFFL' dimension labels render in the elevation SVG (not just the item width). A floor-standing sofa on the same wall gets no mount-height dimension (no clutter).

steps.name: place-mounted-items
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const wall = s.floorPlan.walls.find((w) => Math.hypot(w.end[0]-w.start[0], w.end[1]-w.start[1]) > 3); if (!wall) throw new Error('no long wall found in the default plan'); window.__mountWallId = wall.id; const len = Math.hypot(wall.end[0]-wall.start[0], wall.end[1]-wall.start[1]); const ux = (wall.end[0]-wall.start[0])/len, uz = (wall.end[1]-wall.start[1])/len; const nx = -uz, nz = ux; const along = (t) => [wall.start[0] + ux*len*t + nx*0.08, wall.start[1] + uz*len*t + nz*0.08]; const tvPos = along(0.25); const sconcePos = along(0.6); const sofaPos = along(0.85); s.setItems([ { id: 'mount-tv', defId: 'flatscreen-tv', position: tvPos, rotation: 0, props: { mount: 'wall', mountHeight: 1.1 } }, { id: 'mount-sconce', defId: 'wall-sconce', position: sconcePos, rotation: 0, props: { mountHeight: 1.45 } }, { id: 'mount-sofa', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: sofaPos, rotation: 0, props: {} }, ]); })()

steps.name: verify-items-placed
steps.eval: (() => { const items = window.__store.getState().items; for (const id of ['mount-tv','mount-sconce']) { if (!items.find((i) => i.id === id)) throw new Error(id + ' failed to place (bad defId?)'); } })()

steps.name: select-target-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const idx = s.floorPlan.walls.findIndex((w) => w.id === window.__mountWallId); const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('#elevationPanel .seg:not(.accent) button'); const btn = buttons[idx]; if (!btn) throw new Error('no Wall button at index ' + idx); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-both-mount-heights-drawn
steps.eval: (() => { const html = document.querySelector('#elevationPanel .elev-canvas')?.innerHTML ?? ''; if (!html.includes('1100 AFFL')) throw new Error('TV mount height (1100 AFFL) missing from elevation SVG: ' + html.slice(0, 400)); if (!html.includes('1450 AFFL')) throw new Error('Sconce mount height (1450 AFFL) missing from elevation SVG'); if (/AFFL/.test(html) === false) throw new Error('no AFFL dimension at all'); window.__mountHeightsOk = true; })()

steps.name: assert-sofa-not-annotated
steps.eval: (() => { const html = document.querySelector('#elevationPanel .elev-canvas')?.innerHTML ?? ''; const affls = (html.match(/\d+ AFFL/g) || []); if (affls.length !== 2) throw new Error('expected exactly 2 AFFL dims (TV + sconce), got ' + affls.length + ': ' + affls.join(',')); })()
